predictions.prediction_text: Yen weakness may persist through the first half of 2026.
predictions.expected_result: USD/JPY remains higher (weaker yen) through H1 2026, trading above levels prevailing at January 2026 for most of that period.

predictions.prediction_text: Later in 2026 the yen could strengthen back toward ~140 against the dollar.
predictions.condition: if the US–EU diplomatic dispute is resolved
predictions.expected_result: USD/JPY moves toward and trades near 140 following resolution of the US–EU dispute.

predictions.prediction_text: If BoJ communication leads investors to price earlier tightening, US momentum stock selling can be expected.
predictions.condition: BoJ communication pushes investors to price earlier tightening
predictions.expected_result: US momentum-heavy equities (e.g., mega-cap tech) decline materially versus broader market, showing notable selling pressure.

predictions.prediction_text: Retail-driven option flows and new single-stock expirations will further lift retail volumes and support heavily shorted stocks, compressing downside volatility.
predictions.expected_result: NDX shows reduced intraday downside volatility and relative outperformance of previously heavily shorted stocks during months after January 2026.

predictions.prediction_text: Corporate repurchases should re-accelerate from February 2026, providing an additional demand backstop and further compressing the kurtosis of returns.
predictions.condition: end of blackout periods in late January/early February 2026
predictions.expected_result: In February 2026, buyback activity increases and SPX experiences lower left-tail returns (fewer large intraday drops) compared with January 2026.

predictions.prediction_text: A normalization process is starting to take shape with yield-curve steepening continuing as managers buy longer-dated bonds.
predictions.expected_result: 2s-10s spread widens further from January 2026 levels over subsequent weeks/months.

predictions.prediction_text: Gold will continue to be bid by central banks and ETFs and remains on a path to significantly higher levels this year.
predictions.expected_result: GLD (or spot gold) rises further from January 2026 levels, maintaining or accelerating the year‑to‑date uptrend toward multi-year highs.

predictions.prediction_text: CTAs have built long positions in copper and industrial-metals inflows will sustain copper strength in early 2026.
predictions.expected_result: Copper prices outperform many other commodities and remain elevated or rise further in the weeks following January 2026.

predictions.prediction_text: Into February OpEx there is a meaningful probability of managed sell-offs designed to damp volatility, producing high-volume intraday buy‑the‑dip moves rather than a freefall.
predictions.condition: into February OpEx amid US–EU conflict
predictions.expected_result: Market episodes in February 2026 show high intraday volume with sharp selloffs quickly met by heavy buying, limiting multi-day declines in SPX to managed pullbacks.

predictions.prediction_text: The major US equity indices are only ~1–2% away from levels where CTAs would begin to turn into net sellers, generating asymmetric downside selling if indices fall.
predictions.expected_result: CTA flows flip to net selling and accelerate downside pressure, amplifying market declines beyond the initial 1–2% move.
